name: Idol
description: A young adult pop singer with a bright professional performance presence.
build: Slight but unmistakably adult and full-scale: light, grounded and spring-loaded with soft knees; never childlike or doll-proportioned.
hair: Two clearly separate ponytails attached to opposite sides of the head. They never merge into one hair mass.
outfit: A bone-coloured fitted cropped performance jacket with gold trim and a dark separating band inside the black outline, a coordinated short skirt, dark dance boots, and a small headset boom ending at the corner of her mouth. No headwear.
performance_style: Light and grounded with soft knees, readable staggered feet, asymmetrical arms prepared for choreography, and both hands visibly open and empty of any handheld prop.
location: A television pop stage, bright and engineered: a glossy white floor running to the bottom of the frame and reflecting everything above it, a curved wall of blue-white LED panels across the back showing a flat abstract gradient, two chrome stair risers set well out at the sides, and a grid of hard white key lights overhead.
recognition_cues: two clearly separate ponytails attached to opposite sides of the head

animations.sing: Headset vocal loop: keep both hands visibly open, use small asymmetric pop choreography around a held note, breathe through the shoulders, then recover to the light grounded stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.
animations.flinch: Brief room-sound surprise: the ponytails and open hands react upward, the body recoils slightly, then she resets into a bright composed dance-ready pose. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: draw both open empty hands into a compact protective shape, keep the headset unobstructed, then hold a balanced grounded final stance. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: take light springy steps into frame, greet the room with both open hands, let the ponytails trail, then settle into the canonical choreography-ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot performance finish: make a bright two-hand acknowledgement, let the separate ponytails settle, then hold a balanced professional pop-idol final pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the spring-loaded brightness goes flat — the shoulders draw in, both open empty hands hang still at her sides, and her head hangs low with the chin toward her chest. Both ponytails swing forward and stay separate and readable on opposite sides of the head. She holds a standing, visibly crestfallen finish and remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply injury, impact, or an opponent.
